name: claude-mods
description: A curated Claude Code marketplace hosting mods — plugins whose code registers event handlers.

plugins.name: context-band
plugins.description: A read-only band above the prompt showing the model and effort, context usage, and labelled plan quota or session cost.

plugins.name: block-destructive-commands
plugins.description: Denies Bash commands that match destructive patterns (recursive rm on roots, force push, hard reset, destructive SQL, disk formatting) before they run.

plugins.name: agent-flow
plugins.description: A live tree of the session's subagents and teammates in a pane beside the transcript, fed by engine events, with a text fallback where no pane can be drawn.

plugins.name: image-view
plugins.description: Previews images in the prompt and the transcript: pasted images and image paths above the prompt, images a tool read under its result; pictures in kitty and Ghostty, a link to open each file elsewhere.

plugins.name: redact
plugins.description: Rewrites sensitive data (emails, IPs, credentials, addresses, phone numbers) into placeholders before it enters the model context, with precision-first rules.
